Hi! The timestamps you see on the dashboard are shown in the timezone set for your account. 

1. **Workspace default** – go to **Settings → General** and set the default timezone for the whole workspace. This is used for anyone who hasn’t set a personal timezone.
2. **Personal timezone** – open **Settings → Profile** in your own account and choose the timezone you prefer. This overrides the workspace default just for you and won’t affect anyone else.

After updating the appropriate setting, the dashboard will display times in the new timezone.

Let me know if you need any more help!
